India Lands Jet Using Indigenous GAGAN Navigation Technology

An Indian jet aircraft has successfully landed using the indigenous GAGAN satellite-based navigation system for the first time. This achievement marks a significant step towards self-reliance in aviation technology. The GAGAN system, developed in India, enables aircraft to navigate using satellite signals, potentially reducing reliance on traditional radio systems.
